auth_methods.quote: The projects.locations.notebooks REST API methods on this page require an authenticated user account with an active Gemini Notebook Enterprise license.
auth_methods.note: Google user OAuth access token (gcloud auth print-access-token) sent as Authorization: Bearer. Could also be read as bearer_token; no service-account path documented on page.

credential_access.quote: Get licenses for Gemini Notebook Enterprise and assign a license to your user account.
credential_access.note: Paid per-user license plus Google Cloud project. Note: a separate Public Preview Gemini Notebook API (developers.google.com/notebook) targets personal accounts and may be free; not the Enterprise API in scope.

production_gate.quote: Grant the Cloud NotebookLM User role ( roles/discoveryengine.notebookLmUser ) to your user account.
production_gate.note: Only IAM role + license; no app review documented.

api_type.quote: The projects.locations.notebooks REST API methods on this page

mcp_official.quote: The Gemini Notebook API provides a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server at https://notebook.googleapis.com/mcp
mcp_official.note: Google-run MCP, but for the Gemini Notebook API which currently requires personal Google accounts (Workspace not yet supported); unclear it covers NotebookLM Enterprise notebooks.

main_blocker_type.quote: Get licenses for Gemini Notebook Enterprise and assign a license to your user account.
main_blocker_type.note: Paid license + preview-only user-credential auth; could also be read as technical/access.
